authorship: Original artwork coauthored by LoVis and his mother; breathing is a new motion interpretation.

source_artwork.embedding: Exact JPEG bytes embedded once as data URI; one shared user-space image pattern. No image resampling or recompression in this asset.

source_geometry.normalized_uv_mapping: Original image mapped to the common 820 × 821 source coordinate system. Each group translates its face and pattern together.
source_geometry.limitations: Raster-traced polygons; original tiny-cell subpixel corners remain uncertain. This is not the original vector master.

colors.handling: Exact embedded continuous source gradients; no sampled solid fills, organizational mapping or three-view recoloring.

motion.translation_formula: crest translation = 0.018 × (source centroid − artwork center) × clamp(--bloom-strength,0,2)
motion.wave: 0%/100% resting position; 50% radial crest; cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) on each half; infinite seamless cycle.
motion.ring_rhythm_scope: Local rings within this artwork, not cross-user synchronization.

inline_preview_contract.pause_behavior: Toggle the class on the SVG root to freeze/resume all CSS animation at the current phase.

variables.--bloom-ring-delay: CSS time per ring; default -.14s; zero synchronizes all local rings

inline_preview_contract.reduced_motion: Authoritative: animation:none and transform:none !important; static original rest pose even when presets change.
inline_preview_contract.color_note: Timing presets do not brighten, filter or recolor the embedded artwork.
inline_preview_contract.instance_note: One inline instance per document; prefix IDs if duplicating inline. An img embedding is self-contained but its internal pause class cannot be reached from the parent DOM.

visual_qa.scope: Structural XML, source-byte, geometry-bound and CSS contract checks only. No browser rendering, playback inspection or visual QA was performed.
